'''Caleb Clancy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who worked as a security guard on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Clancy worked as a security guard for the pharmaceutical company [[Culpharm]] and normally carried out his duties in a processing plant on the planet Cularin. He lived in an apartment complex with his wife and children.

In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Clancy and his family attended a picnic that was organized by the [[Paradise Towers' Residents Social Association]] and he operated a barbecue there. He disliked the picnic and considered it a waste of his day off work and only attended because his wife had wanted him to. While he was there, an agent working for [[Biotherapy]], a rival company of Culpharm, posed as Clancy to steal a Culpharm specimen sample. The next day, the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who were investigating the theft of the sample, asked Clancy a few questions.

==Personality and traits==
Clancy was asocial and disliked dealing with people, so was generally suspicious of strangers. He was also very grumpy. He was small and had blond-colored hair.

==Behind the scenes==
Caleb Clancy appeared in ''[[Trade Wars: Mix 'n Match|Mix and Match]]''.
